description: This file defines the ParagraphFormat class, which manages paragraph formatting properties in the MigraDoc document object model, including cloning, serialization, and property management.

classes.name: ParagraphFormat
classes.description: Represents paragraph formatting options within a document, including properties for alignment, indentation, spacing, borders, shading, and tab stops, with methods for cloning and serialization.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the ParagraphFormat object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the internal deep copy of the object, including cloning nested objects.

methods.name: AddTabStop
methods.description: Adds a tab stop at a specified position, with optional alignment and leader.

methods.name: RemoveTabStop
methods.description: Removes a tab stop at the specified position.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all tab stops from the collection.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the ParagraphFormat into DDL format.
